name: BTC MAX(10) selected overnight sessions
author: Cyril Dujava / QuantPedia
instruments_timeframes_claimed: BTC; Fri-Mon, Mon-Tue, Tue-Wed NYSE overnight intervals
indicators: 10-day rolling high on NYSE close data; NYSE calendar
entry_long: At close, go long if BTC is at a local 10-day maximum and upcoming interval is Fri-Mon, Mon-Tue, or Tue-Wed.
exit: Exit at next NYSE morning open.
filters: Trade only named intervals and when MAX(10) condition holds
claimed_performance: Authors claim attractive Sharpe and low risk; historical sample and selection caveats apply.
implementation_notes: Clarify holiday/weekend timestamp alignment and repeated eligible night re-entry.
